_comment: Per-diagram render overrides for the PDF, keyed by the order the diagrams appear in the appendix. The source keeps what reads best on GitHub; the page has a different shape to fill. Only diagrams that need an override appear here.

2._why: A star around the record. Top-down it comes out wide and flat, so the page can only render it small; left-right makes it nearly square and it fills the text width. The wide node spacing separates the fourteen edge labels that otherwise pile up where they meet the record.
